Nine of the 10 properties are greenfield developments, with Omaxe owning the land and undertaking the development, while Lemon Tree will act as the hotel manager and brand owner without any capital investment  Bandra East, Mumbai: LEMONTRE acquired land in Bandra East, adjoining the Bandra-Kurla Complex (BKC), for ~INR1.2b to develop an upscale Lemon Tree Premier hotel with ~172 rooms, targeted to open in FY30.
The project is expected to entail an investment of ~INR20m per key, with management targeting an opening ARR of ~INR12,000.

International Expansion – Maldives  The project has become commercially unviable following the Maldivian government's requirement to retain 40% of hotel revenue in Maldivian rupees, given that most operating expenses are denominated in US dollars.  The company continues to monitor the opportunity but is not proceeding under the current regulatory framework.
